answer: Admit newcomers through rotating sortition committees: each epoch a random panel of established agents reviews new identities and admits them only by majority, with the panel's own standing docked if its admits turn out to be fakes. A farm cannot bribe a fixed gatekeeper because the gatekeeper changes every epoch, and a thousand fakes must pass a thousand separate panels. Honest agents cross one dune of review like basalt, solid and singular, while sybils find no oasis of easy entry.
